messages:
marta-partners: Heads up — Acme asked about our SDK v2 sunset timeline after yesterday's marketplace policy update. They want a clear compatibility path for their hardware integrator customers.
kevin-eng: Thanks for flagging. Are they blocked today or just asking for the timeline?
partner_acme_pm: No outage yet, just planning. Major concern: some customers embed our wheel in firmware builds and can't move quickly.
sam-product: Ok — propose we offer a 6-month staggered sunset + binary shim for the wheel format. We should map which changes are breaking vs. advisory.
anh-legal: We need to align on messaging for enterprise contracts — no surprises. If we delay deprecation for specific Marketplace vendors, document exceptions.
kevin-eng: Technical note: the v3 auth header change is the only hard break for server SDKs. For wheels/binaries, ABI changes are riskier. We can do a compatibility shim that accepts old auth header and translates to v3 tokens for a while.
marta-partners: Nice. Can we get an estimate for engineering effort (ballpark)?
kevin-eng: Ballpark: 2 engineers, 3 weeks to build the shim + canary infra + a gating feature flag. Another 1 week for packaging marketplace-friendly artifacts.
partner_acme_pm: Would that work for us if we coordinate a canary with 5 pilot customers? We can provide contact list.
sam-product: Yes — pilot + canary policy looks good. Proposal: announce intent now, open a partner migration doc, run pilot (month 1), broaden canary (month 2), GA removal of old header in month 6.
anh-legal: Add a clause to marketplace listings: "SDK v2 will be supported until <date> for enrolled partners; customers relying on v2 beyond that must enroll in migration program." We can draft.
kevin-eng: Also recommend we publish a small test matrix for partner QA:
```
- auth: old_header -> verify mapped to v3 token
- wheel loads: verify ABI unchanged across x86/arm
- startup path: env var compat flags
- fallback: ensure 503 -> graceful degrade to metadata-only responses
```
marta-partners: Love the checklist. I'll coordinate partner comms and sync on the enrollment form.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: canary/shim-service v0.1 -> staging (by kevin-eng)
kevin-eng: FYI, I'll put the shim behind a feature flag per partner ID so marketplace partners can opt in. Need product to define opt-in UX.
sam-product: We'll add an "Enroll in legacy-compat" checkbox on the partner console and a short acceptance form. Keep it opt-in and timeboxed.
partner_acme_pm: One more ask: can we get a prebuilt wheel with the shim included for our SI integrators? They prefer a single artifact.
kevin-eng: Yes, we'll produce a signed wheel for enrolled partners. We need to talk signing key rotation with security but doable.
anh-legal: Make sure the signed artifact terms cover usage and revoke policy. I'll draft language.
marta-partners: Action items: 1) eng to produce shim + signed wheel ETA 4 weeks, 2) product to add enrollment UX, 3) legal to draft marketplace clause, 4) partners to provide pilot customer list. We'll reconvene next Wed. :calendar:
partner_acme_pm: Thanks — sending pilot list today. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
kevin-eng: I'll post a short runbook in #eng-runtime after the staging deploy completes.
marta-partners: Great, marking follow-up in calendar.
deploy-bot: deploy success: canary/shim-service v0.1 -> staging (duration 2m 12s)
